description: Checks whether an email address's domain (or a domain you give) is on the community disposable and temporary email blocklist (about 9,900 domains). Only the domain is checked, never the mailbox, and a domain missing from the list is not proven to be permanent. Choose this tool for: Checks whether an email address's domain is. Close alternatives on this server: security_surbl_uri_lookup (Checks a domain against SURBL's multi-list: whether it); security_barracuda_reputation (Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

email.description: Email address or domain, e.g. user@mailinator.com or mailinator.com (required)
